name: Tom Gundersen
why_notable: systemd developer who wrote the original systemd-resolved: the 2014 manual page and sources carry 'Copyright 2014 Tom Gundersen' and list him as developer of the Network Name Resolution manager. Working alongside systemd-networkd, the service let Linux keep DNS servers per network link instead of in one global /etc/resolv.conf, the foundation that later became the caching DNS, LLMNR, mDNS, DNSSEC and DNS-over-TLS resolver that resolvectl controls today.
